book.title: Toto Thovuye Utuniye Jon Le Rorori

content: Lasarus le mare
Amala regha idae Lasarus, i ghambwera. Va i yaku Betani weiyaŋgiya olouye Meri na Mata.
(Merike iyake iya va i liŋgiya bunama Jisas e ghegheŋgima na i ivamoŋgi e umbaliye ndamwandamwae. Louye Lasarus iyava i ghambwerako.)
Oloulouye thɨ variya toto thɨŋa, “Amalana, amalama valɨgharegharenɨma i ghambwera.”
Mbaŋa Jisas i loŋwe iyake iŋa, “Ghambwerake iyake mane le ghambako Lasarus le mare. Nandere, iyake Loi ghatarawa kaiwae, na mbala thɨ taraweŋa Loi Nariye.”
Jisas i gharethovu weŋgiya Mata na ghaghae Meri na lounji Lasarus.
Ko iyemaeŋge mbaŋa i loŋwe totoma, Lasarus i ghambwera, Jisas mbowo i yakuva mbaŋa theghewo e ghembako inakowe.
Amba i dage weŋgiya gharaghambuma iŋa, “Wo ra rakanjogha Judiya.”
Gharaghambuma thɨ gonjoghawe thɨŋa, “Ravavaghare, mendamba gharɨgharɨ gheko nuwanjiya thɨ unɨghɨŋge e varɨ, na buda kaiwae nuwaniya u njogha gheko?”
Jisas iŋa, “Mbaŋa ghalughawoghawo theyaworo na theghewo, ŋgoreiye? Thela ne i loŋga varae i mbɨlembɨle mane i lirawe vatharɨ gheghe kaiwae i thuwe yambaneke ghamanjamanjala.
Ko thoŋgo ne i loŋga gougou ne i tɨvatɨva, kaiwae ma ele manjamanjala.”
Jisas i utuŋaŋgiya thiyake na e ghereiye mbowo i dageva weŋgi iŋa, “Ghandauma Lasarus i ghenelaŋa, ko ne ya wa na va yavairɨ.”
Gharaghambuma thɨ gonjoghawe thɨŋa, “Amalana, thoŋgo i ghenelaŋa, tembene riwae i thovuye.”
Jisas emunjoru moli i utuŋa Lasarus le mare kaiwae, ko gharaghambuma thɨŋaeŋge i utuŋa ghena utuniye.
Jisas i uturaŋgiya moli weŋgi iŋa, “Lasarus iye i mare,
na ghemi kaiwami ya warari kaiwae ma inaŋgu gheko, iyake kaiwae ne hu ghareghare na hu vareminjeŋgo. Mbaŋake ra rakawawe.”
Tomas, vambe thɨ unova ghaida unouno Gamwaruwo, i dage weŋgiya ghauneko iya Jisas gharaghambuko weiyaŋgi iŋa, “Taulaghɨke ghinda ra raka weinda Ravavaghareko, mbala vara mare weinda.”
Jisas iye thuweiru na yawalɨ
Mbaŋa Jisas i vutha, i loŋwevaidiya Lasarus thɨ beku na ghenevarɨ vama ve ghena e ghabubu.
Betani na Jerusalem ghanjilughawoghawo mbalama i wo kilomita thegheto.
Iya kaiwae gharɨgharɨ lemoyo thɨ ri Jerusalem na thɨ vawarariŋaŋgiya Mata na Meri lounjiko le mare na nuwatharɨniye kaiwae.
Mbaŋa Mata i loŋwe toto Jisas maiya i menamenake, i raŋgi na ve lavolevole, ko Meri vambe i reyaku e ŋgolo tɨne.
Mata i dagewe Jisas iŋa, “Thoŋgo mendava inan gheke, Amalana, louŋguma mbala ma menda i mare!
Ko ya ghareghare othembe mbaŋake, budakaiya u naŋgo weya Loi na i vakatha, ne i vakatha kaiwan.”
Jisas i dagewe iŋa, “Lounɨna ne i thuweiru na tembe e yawayawaliyeva.”
Mata i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Ya ghareghare, ne i thuweiru na e yawayawaliye mbaŋa nevole ele ghambako.”
Jisas i dagewe iŋa, “Ghino thuweiru na yawalɨ. Thela ne i loŋweghathɨŋgo ne e yawayawaliye, othembe ne i mare;
na thela e yawayawaliye na i loŋweghathɨŋgo ma vole i mare. Thare u loŋweghathɨgha iyake?”
Mata i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Ŋgoreiye Amalana! Ya loŋweghathɨgha ghen Mesaiya, Loi Nariye, iye Loi va i dagerawe ne i mena e yambaneke.”
Jisas i randa
Mata i utuvao na e ghereiye, i njogha na i kulavatha ghaghae Meri na i vaŋaewiwe iŋa, “La Ravavaghare maina gheke na nuwaiyaŋge.”
Mbaŋa Meri i loŋwe iyake, i yondo na i yorukuwe.
Jisas ma vamba i vutha e ghemba, ko vamba ina ŋgora Mata me vaidimawe.

Gharɨgharɨma va inanjima e ŋgoloko tɨne weinjima Meri, thɨ vawarariŋama nuwatharɨma kaiwae, thɨ rakambele mbaŋa thɨ thuwe i yondo vɨrɨ na i rukuraŋgi. Lenji renuwaŋa thɨŋaeŋge i wa e ghabubuko na ve randawe.
Meri ve vutha ŋgora Jisas inamawe na mbaŋa i thuwe, i dobu e gheghe na i dagewe iŋa, “Amalana, thoŋgo mendambe inan gheke, louŋguma mbala ma mendava i mare!”
Jisas i thuwe Meri i randa na gharɨgharɨma weiyaŋgima mbe ŋgoreiyeva, ghare i tage laghɨye moli,
na i vaitoŋgi iŋa, “Aŋga ina menda hu worawe?” Thɨ gonjoghawe thɨŋa, “Amalana, u mena vara thuwe.”
Jisas i randa.
Gharɨgharɨma thɨ ve dage weŋgi thɨŋa, “Wo u thuwe, ŋgoroŋga ghare weya Lasarus!”
Ko vavana thɨŋa, “Va i vakatha amala marae i kwaghe na kaero i thuwe, na buda kaiwae ma i vikiki Lasarus na thava i mare?”
Lasarus kaero e yawayawaliyeva
Ghare i vɨrɨ laghɨye, Jisas i wa e ghabubuma, va maŋgavarɨ, na va thɨ wogana ghae e varɨ.
Jisas i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Hu wovakatha varɨna!” Amalama mendamba i marema louye Mata i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Amalana, kaero e butibutiye na ghenevarɨ kaero ve ghena.”
Jisas i dagewe iŋa, “Mendambe ya dage e ghen ne u thuwe ŋgoroŋga Loi le vurɨvurɨgheghe thoŋgo u loŋweghathɨ?”
Thɨ mwanavakatha varɨma. Jisas i ghɨmara voro e buruburu na iŋa, “Ya vata ago e ghen, Bwebwe, kaiwae u vandeŋeŋgo.
Ya ghareghare mbaŋake wolaghɨye u vandeŋeŋgo, ko ya utuŋa iyake gharɨgharɨke thiyake kaiwanji na mbala thɨ loŋweghathɨgha iya ghen va u variyeŋgo.”
I naŋgo na ŋgoreiyako e ghereiye amba i kula na ghalɨŋae laghɨye iŋa, “Lasarus, u raŋgima!”
I raŋgi, ghegheŋgi na nɨmanɨmae mbe weiye vara ghavoghavo na ghamwae vambe ŋgoreiyeva. Jisas i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Hu rakayathuŋgiya riwaena ghaghavoghavo na hu viyathu i wa.”
Thɨ vona Jisas ghae
Jiu iyava thɨ mena thɨ thuwe Meri, thɨ ghanagha va thɨ loŋweghathɨgha Jisas mbaŋaniye thɨ thuwe budakai va i vakatha e maranji.
Ko vavana thɨ rakanjogha na vethɨ utugiya weŋgiya Parisi budakaiya Jisas va i vakatha.

Amba ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye na Parisi thɨ kula vathavathaŋgiya Jiu lenji kot laghɨye giyagiyaniye na thɨ niva. Thɨŋa, “Ne ra vakatha budakai? Wo hu thuwe vakathaŋgike ghamba rotaele wolaghɨye amalake iyake i vakathaŋgi!
Thoŋgo ra gheneviyathu na i rombeleya kamwathɨke iyake, gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye ne thɨ loŋweghathɨ iyake, amba Rom gharambarombaro thɨ mena thɨ vakowana la Ŋgolo Bobomake na la ghamba mbaroke.”
Amba regha, idae Kaiyapas, iye va ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye lenji randeviva e theghatheghako iyako e tɨne i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Ma hu ghareghare bigi regha.
Thare hu thuwe ghakamwathɨ? Ne i thovuye moli e ghemi thoŋgo lolo regha moli i mare gharɨgharɨ kaiwanji na thava vanautumako laghɨye thɨ vaidiya vuyowo.”

Iyake mava i utuŋa ghamberegha ele renuwaŋa, ko kaiwae amalaghɨniye va Ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye lenji randeviva e theghatheghako iyako, iyava i utuŋakai amba muyai i yomara, iyava iŋake Jisas ne i mare Jiu kaiwanji.
Ma mbe Jiu eŋge kaiwanji, ko tembe ŋgoreiyeva Loi le ŋgaŋga e yambaneke laghɨye, i mbanɨvathavathaŋgi na regha.
Va e mbaŋako iyako na i ghaoko Jiu lenji randeviva thɨ worawe lenji renuwaŋa rɨghewe na nuwanjiya thɨ vona Jisas ghae le mare kaiwae.

Iya kaiwae Jisas ma vama i reŋa ŋgora gharɨgharɨ lemoyo inanjiwe Judiya e tɨne. Ko iyemaeŋge i iteta valɨvaŋgako iyako na i wa e ghemba regha idae Ipɨreim, e njamnjam ghadidiye, na ve yakuwe weiyaŋgiya gharaghambu.

Mbaŋa vama Thaga Valaŋani i ghenetha, na gharɨgharɨ lemoyo vama thiya wareri e ghembaghemba na thɨ raka Jerusalem na vethɨ vanamwe riwanji ŋgoreiye ghanjimbaroko, amba muyai Thaga Valaŋaniko ghambaŋa.
Va thɨ tamwetamweya Jisas, na mbaŋa thɨ mevathavatha e Ŋgolo Boboma le valɨvaŋga, thɨ ve vaitoŋgi thɨŋa, “Ŋgoroŋga lemi renuwaŋa? Ne i mena e thagako o nandere?”
Ravowovowo laghɨlaghɨye na Parisi thɨ dage weŋgiya gharɨgharɨ na thoŋgo thela i ghareghare Jisas aŋga inae, i wa ve utugiya weŋgi na mbala thɨ yalawe.
